item.title: Sailhand: A Native Touch Screen for Klipper with Happy Hare, AFC, Tool Changers and Spoolman
item.description: Announcing Sailhand, my open-source touch screen app for Klipper printers. What it does, what is cool about it, and how to install and try it on a Raspberry Pi or a BTT CB1.

item.title: Flash the BTT Manta M8P and EBB42 with Klipper Using Katapult
item.description: A quick guide to flashing Klipper with Katapult onto the BTT Manta M8P and EBB42 boards over CAN bus (Sidewinder X2), plus the USB variant for the Manta M8P v2.0 and EBB SB2209 (Voron 2.4).

item.title: Get Accurate Print Time Estimates with Klipper Estimator
item.description: Learn how to dramatically improve 3D print time predictions in Klipper using the Klipper Estimator plugin. Step-by-step setup for Moonraker, Mainsail, and KlipperScreen, plus a breakdown of what makes Klipper Estimator more accurate than slicers.

item.title: Flash Armbian onto the BigTreeTech CB1 eMMC Compute Module
item.description: A step-by-step guide to flashing Armbian Linux onto the eMMC version of the BigTreeTech CB1 compute module from a Windows machine.

item.title: Use Your BigTreeTech TouchScreen with Klipper on the Sidewinder X2
item.description: How to make the integrated BigTreeTech TFT touchscreen of the Artillery Sidewinder X2 work with Klipper and Mainsail, using a Raspberry Pi or CB1, a level shifter, and a serial bridge.

item.title: Install the ADXL345 and Calibrate Input Shaping on the Artillery Sidewinder X2 and Genius Pro
item.description: Shows how to install an ADXL345 accelerometer and calibrate input shaping (resonance compensation) with Klipper on an Artillery Sidewinder X2 or Genius Pro.

item.title: Filament and Spool Parameters of My 3D Printer Filaments
item.description: My list of relevant information about the different filaments I printed with, including weights, print temperature, retraction, and flow.

item.title: Re-enable the Filament Runout Sensor of the Artillery Sidewinder X2
item.description: Shows how to re-enable the stock filament runout sensor of the Artillery Sidewinder X2 by moving it to the z-endstop pins and configuring it in Klipper.

item.title: Must-Have Mainsail, Klipper, and Cura Configuration for the Artillery Sidewinder X2
item.description: Walks through the must-have Mainsail, Klipper, and Cura slicer configuration files and G-code macros for the Artillery Sidewinder X2.

item.title: Replace Marlin with Klipper on the Artillery Sidewinder X2
item.description: Shows an easy way to replace the Marlin firmware of the Artillery Sidewinder X2 with Klipper, using a Raspberry Pi running MainsailOS.

item.title: Flash the Latest Marlin Firmware to the Artillery Sidewinder X2
item.description: Step-by-step guide to flash my compiled Marlin firmware to the Artillery Sidewinder X2 (Artillery Ruby v1.2 mainboard) with Pronterface and STM32CubeProgrammer.

item.title: Why I Chose the Artillery Sidewinder X2 as My First 3D Printer
item.description: The decision, pros, and cons of buying an Artillery Sidewinder X2 as a first FDM 3D printer.

item.title: Set Up Rust and Bevy in WSL2 on Windows 11
item.description: Some easy steps to set up an initial Rust development environment in Windows 11 WSL2/Ubuntu Linux, together with the libraries needed to compile and run all of the Bevy examples, using the graphical WSL implementation (WSLg).

item.title: Install fish and Oh My Fish with the Bob the Fish Theme in WSL2
item.description: How to install fish, a very helpful modern bash alternative, together with Oh My Fish and the Bob the Fish theme in WSL2/Ubuntu, and how to fix the powerline fonts.

item.title: Install and Update Windows Applications with WinGet 1.0
item.description: A short intro to the finally released WinGet 1.0, the native Microsoft package manager to install, uninstall, and update most of your daily used applications on Windows.

item.title: Why I Prefer Arch Linux
item.description: The pros and cons of Arch Linux compared to other popular Linux distributions, and why it is my favorite.
